notes.charcoal_note__q3: Heavy speckled noise over the whole frame, detail lost.
notes.girl_finds_him__q3: Same noise; the girl turned into an older woman.
notes.verdict::Version (quantisation): Q3_K_M is broken for this model: grainy speckle everywhere and lost detail, only ~10% faster. Stick with Q6_K; Q3_K_M can be deleted (frees 10 GB on C: and 10 GB on D:).
notes.charcoal_note__base: Beautiful ember light, but he stands at a ledge and his profile shows.
notes.girl_finds_him__base: Strong: a convincing young girl, kit matches the reference.
notes.charcoal_note__steps20: Softer; the wall cracks and fire are less defined.
notes.charcoal_note__steps50: Same quality as 30; the pose shifts slightly (holds the paper up).
notes.girl_finds_him__steps20: Fine at a glance, slightly softer textures.
notes.verdict::Steps: 30 steps is the sweet spot. 20 is a little soft (fine for quick drafts); 50 costs +60% time for no visible gain.
notes.charcoal_note__cfg2.5: Softer, flatter contrast; the fire and wall cracks are less punchy. Same composition.
notes.girl_finds_him__cfg2.5: Hazier, more muted and natural; the neck cloth no longer covers his lower face (less faithful to the prompt).
notes.charcoal_note__cfg6: More contrast and texture in the wall, deeper greens in the shadows; a teal colour cast creeps in. Composition shifts slightly.
notes.girl_finds_him__cfg6: Crisper and more saturated, goats sharper, but a goat merges oddly into the girl; slight over-processed look.
notes.verdict::Text guidance (cfg): cfg 4 is the best balance. 2.5 is softer and follows the prompt less (the face cloth slipped); 6 adds punch but brings a teal cast and small artefacts.
notes.charcoal_note__img2.0: Same man; the pose shifts (paper held up). No gain in likeness.
notes.verdict::Reference strength (img_cfg): Barely matters between 1.0 and 2.0: Mauro looks the same in all three. Keep 1.5; it is not the lever for consistency.
notes.charcoal_note__norm_none: Warmer, brighter and more saturated orange; the hand lost the charcoal stick (holding nothing). Global keeps it more controlled.
notes.charcoal_note__shift5: Composition changes (fire in a hollow, paper held up over it); detail similar. Not better, slightly less believable.
notes.verdict::Thinking mode: Not usable on an 8 GB card: with thinking on, the model is pushed almost entirely out of VRAM; the first step took 30 minutes and the estimate was ~15 hours per image. Cancelled.
notes.charcoal_note__noref: Text-only gets surprisingly close (same shirt, pack, wrap) and is ~35% faster (3.5 vs 5.4 min), but the face is more visible and the look drifts from the reference.
notes.charcoal_note__seed2: Different pose (paper held up, fire on the floor); same man and mood.
notes.charcoal_note__seed3: Writes on paper held in the air, a little awkward; same look.
notes.girl_finds_him__seed2: Different framing, darker goats; consistent man and girl.
notes.verdict::Seed: Seeds change pose and composition, not identity or quality: the man and the look stay consistent. Generating 2-3 seeds per shot and picking the best is the best use of extra time.
notes.charcoal_note__res1920: Native full HD, only ~13% slower (6.1 vs 5.4 min). Crisp fabric and strap detail; the composition reframes closer (a new size acts like a new seed).
notes.girl_finds_him__res1920: Full HD with crisp detail; reframed composition. Same consistency as 1344.
notes.verdict::Resolution: 1920x1088 native is only ~13% slower and noticeably crisper: use it for final stills.
notes.verdict::Guidance limiter (cfg_norm): Keep global: turning it off gave a warmer, punchier image but lost prompt details (the charcoal stick vanished).
notes.verdict::Shift: Keep 3: shift 5 reshuffled the composition without improving detail.
notes.verdict::Reference image: Keep the reference: text-only is ~35% faster and close, but the face shows more and the look drifts.
notes.summary:
VERDICT: SenseNova U1.5 is a strong local option, roughly on par with FLUX 3 Klein for quality, better on some scenes (a convincing young girl, natural goats), weaker on others (the charcoal pose). It is about 10x slower than Klein (5-6 min vs 30 s per still).
Best settings on an RTX 3070 Ti 8 GB: Q6_K, 1920x1088, 30 steps, cfg 4, img_cfg 1.5, cfg_norm global, shift 3, thinking OFF, with the Mauro reference image, 2-3 seeds per shot. About 6 minutes per still.
What does not work: the Q3_K_M version (heavy noise), thinking mode (~15 h per image on 8 GB), 50 steps (no gain), cfg 6 (teal cast), shift 5 (no gain).
Where it fits: a free, unlimited backup for Gemini when the daily limits run out, and for scenes with several people. Klein stays the fast option; Gemini stays the quality pick.
